life_stage: A child devotee in the early lifespan episode and a mature, long-lived ascetic in the later story scenes.

visual_bible.skin: Natural warm-brown human skin, not orange; skin-only patch red-minus-blue below 120.
visual_bible.face: Serene, compassionate South Asian features; child proportions only in the lifespan episode, mature sage proportions thereafter.
visual_bible.hair: Dark hair; tied in a modest ascetic topknot as a mature sage.
visual_bible.clothing: Simple cream or muted ochre dhoti and plain shoulder cloth, no ornate jewelry.
visual_bible.anatomy: One head, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet; natural human proportions.
visual_bible.style: Flat matte mineral-color temple mural with firm dark contours and shallow decorative space.

depiction_rules.notes: Keep the same gentle identity across the boy and sage phases. The child appears only in the lifespan episode; later Markandeya is a mature ascetic. Do not turn him into Shiva or another deity.

never: no duplicated sage within a scene
no fused bodies or detached limbs
no readable text, signature, logo or watermark
no glossy skin, metallic gold, cinematic rays or beams
note: New D097 character contract; no character image master is implied or approved.
